en: A vintage multi-view postcard showing four black‑and‑white photographs of an outdoor bath and park complex with pavilions, pools and landscaped walkways. The main building has a domed central rotunda and surrounding wings; other views show a large swimming pool, stone balustrades, and people walking in the bath grounds. At the bottom of the picture side the captions read "Pécs" and "Strandfürdő". The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text in blue ink, a Hungarian postage stamp labelled "MAGYAR POSTA", a pink propaganda cachet, and the Budapest-based publisher imprint MONOSTORY / KALANTAY.
